description: Source code implementing GRE interface management functions, including creation, initialization, and removal of GRE interface objects, with external dependencies on DML functions and internal data structures.

methods.name: CosaCGreCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new COSA_DATAMODEL_CGRE object, setting function pointers and calling its initialize method.

methods.name: CosaCGreInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the GRE interface data, retrieves existing entries, assigns instance numbers, and sets interface aliases.

methods.name: CosaCGreRemove
methods.description: Finalizes and frees the GRE data object.
